newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL gives AAA (SO) rating for GECSI.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL gives AAA (SO) rating for GECSI.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Tuesday it assigned a 'AAA(SO)' rating to the 1.0 billion rupees non-convertible debenture issue of GE Capital Services India (GECSI).
This rating indicates highest safety with respect to the timely payment of interest and principal on the instrument.

The rating takes into account the support mechanism from General Electric Capital Corporation, USA (GECC), a 100 percent subsidiary of GE Capital Services Incorporated (GECS), USA for ensuring timely payment of obligations on the rated instrument.
GECS is the largest lessor in the world and is the only full service U.S. Financial Institution with "AAA" ratings from Standard & Poor's and Moody's.
For the year 1996, GECS had a total earned income of US$ 32,713 million and net earnings of US$2,817 million.

The support mechanism from GECC is in the form of a "keep well agreement" which would ensure timely payment on the debt obligations of GECSI. This rating also factors the current shareholding pattern of the company.

GECSI is a 100 percent owned subsidiary of GECS and was set up in October, 1993 to carry out financial services activities including leasing, commercial equipment financing, loans, bills discounting, project finance, portfolio refinance and capital market operations.
